notes.title: PATCH NOTES PROJECT TAPE 1.1
notes.content:
[b]NEW OPTIONS AND BUG FIXES[/b]

-A new option has been added to the main menu that takes you directly to the game's settings menu so you can configure everything before starting.

-The crouching and jumping options have been removed, as they were only causing errors.

-The 'FOV' option has been removed from the main menu to make the experience more immersive.

-A fog bug that was making things difficult to see has been fixed.

-New achievements have been added to the demo.

-----------------------------------------

These are preparations for August 29th.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES JUN | THE LAST TAPE PROLOGUE 1.0
notes.content:
[h2]🛠️ [b]Patch Notes 1.0 – The Last Tape: Prologue[/b][/h2][p]This update marks the release of the [b]final version[/b] of the prologue. All changes and improvements included in this patch are the result of feedback received during the DEMO period – thank you for your support![/p][p]⚠️ [b]The demo will be removed one day before the official release.[/b]
The final version will be available for [b]free[/b] during [b]June[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h3]✨ [b]General Improvements[/b][/h3][p]🔁 Full rework of the first area[/p][p]The starting area was completely rebuilt from the ground up. Thanks to the new lighting system and redesigned structure, the experience is now far more immersive and much clearer than in the demo.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44807960/51532a1d89e6f034dda2e8e7e5efe31b470d4bf7.png"][/img][/p][p]⚙️ Optimization[/p][p]We've significantly reduced the game's disk space and RAM usage. You may notice smoother performance throughout. However, please note that the [b]minimum system requirements remain unchanged[/b], as listed on the Steam store page.[/p][p]🗣️ Spanish Voice Acting[/p][p]The game now features voice acting in [b]Spanish (V.O.)[/b] for the [b]main character[/b] and several [b]audio tapes[/b], which play a key role in understanding the story.[/p][p]📖 Expanded Story[/p][p]The narrative has been expanded to provide a stronger introduction to the universe of [i]The Last Tape[/i]. While it keeps a cryptic and mysterious tone, you'll now be able to follow the dark path of the [b]Lurmont Corporation[/b] into its deepest nightmare.[/p][p]🗺️ Updated Maps[/p][p]All previously existing maps have been [b]reworked[/b], fixing many design issues and adding new areas. These changes ensure a fresh experience even for those who played the demo.[/p][p]🖥️ Brand New Interface[/p][p]A completely redesigned UI allows you to [b]inspect items[/b] and [b]track collected elements[/b] more easily, helping you follow the story without missing key details.[/p][p]🏆 Achievements & Easter Eggs[/p][p]We believe replayability is essential, so we've added [b]hidden easter eggs[/b] and [b]fully integrated achievements[/b] for you to discover and unlock.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed character-related bugs and strange audio glitches when interacting with objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved texture loading issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned the main menu – all settings now function correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue that allowed players to leave the playable area.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed floating text elements.[/p][/*][*][p]Footstep sound effects were improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Tunnel collisions adjusted to avoid head clipping.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the object inspection system.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed ability to walk through trees in the first zone.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a new lighting system for better visibility.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]...And many more minor fixes![/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.95 | The Last Tape Prologue Demo
notes.content:
Patch Notes 0.95 – The Last Tape: Prologue Demo
This patch prepares the demo for its final stage before the full release.

Changes and Improvements:
Removed the initial menu, which is being redesigned for the final version. It will return with Patch 1.0.

Removed intrusive on-screen text during gameplay. This also fixes the issue where some texts would freeze on screen.

Fixed incorrect sound that played when interacting with certain objects.

Enabled static textures on the mountain area to prevent visual instability.

Reduced game size from 12.5 GB to 7 GB.

Optimized several objects and textures to improve performance and increase FPS (this will be more noticeable in version 1.0).

Removed all demo achievements, except for the one granted upon completion. This achievement will remain available until the final release day.

Added a visible character body (alpha phase, using Unreal Engine's basic character model).

Removed action and sound delays for a smoother experience.

This update ensures the demo remains playable during its final stage.

If you encounter any issues, feel free to report them.

notes.title: 'Visions' The Last Tape Prologue Update in April
notes.content:
[b]WE ARE READING YOU
[/b]
We are aware that many people are enjoying the way the game is progressing, while others find it too slow or dense at the beginning.

We are gathering all the feedback you’ve been sharing, and it will all be reflected in the "Visions" update, which will officially mark the beginning of the Prologue, removing the "demo" label. In this version, we will fix numerous optimization and gameplay issues while adding a lot of new content. We will also make changes to various aspects that we’ve noticed some players didn’t fully enjoy.

This update will be available during the first week of April, and we will be sharing more details soon.

Thank you all for trying out the demo of The Last Tape: Prologue!
